title: Credibility in school choice
abstract: arXiv:2608.29597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In centralized school choice, a designer who announces a mechanism may deviate from it to favor some students without being detected. A mechanism is credible if it admits no such deviation. We study this credibility problem when students do not know others' reports and may observe only part of the assignment. Credibility is demanding: among common school choice mechanisms, only deferred acceptance is credible, and only when students observe enough of the assignment. We therefore rank mechanisms by their credibility. Deferred acceptance is more credible than any other stable mechanism and strictly more credible than the Boston mechanism, regardless of how much of the assignment students observe. Its ranking relative to top trading cycles and efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance depends on disclosure: deferred acceptance is strictly more credible when students observe the entire assignment, whereas the ranking reverses when students obs

translated_abstract: 在集中式学校选择中，宣布某种机制的机制设计者可能会偏离该机制以偏袒某些学生而不被发现。如果一个机制不存在此类偏离，则称其为可信的。我们研究了当学生不知道其他人的申报且可能只能观察到分配结果的一部分时的可信性问题。可信性的要求很高：在常见的学校选择机制中，只有延迟接受机制是可信的，而且仅当学生能够观察到足够多的分配结果时才如此。因此，我们根据可信性对各种机制进行排序。延迟接受机制比任何其他稳定机制都更可信，并且无论学生观察到多少分配结果，它都严格比波士顿机制更可信。它相对于最优交易循环机制和效率调整的延迟接受机制的排名则取决于信息披露：当学生观察到全部分配结果时，延迟接受机制严格更可信；而当学生只观察到部分分配结果时，排名则会反转。
tldr: 该论文针对集中式学校选择中机制设计者可能暗中偏离所宣布机制以偏袒部分学生的问题，提出了“可信性”这一新概念，证明在常见机制中只有延迟接受机制是可信的，并据此按可信性对各种机制进行了排序。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of credibility in centralized school choice—whether a designer can deviate from an announced mechanism undetected—and shows that among common mechanisms only deferred acceptance is credible, thereby ranking mechanisms by their credibility.
